evidence_rules: The 1928 association foundation establishes deep institutional history but does not imply high national scale.
Historical state context is preserved through colonial Singapore, the Malaysia period and independence in 1965 without changing the local association identity mechanically.
The 2021 Junior Tennis Initiative signal is gated to 2021 and is not a total-participation count.
The 2026 J60 at Kallang Tennis Hub supports current junior competition/development infrastructure only.
No player rankings or tournament outcomes are calibration targets.
